about: Every fix made on the author's own setup, and the buyer file it becomes. Rule: a buyer's YouCloned environment has every 'yes' and 'adapt' row from day one. Add a row in a PR the same day a fix ships. 'author' rows are fixes only the author's setup needs. 'check' is {"mac": ..., "pc": ...}: the command that proves the fix on that computer, run from the add-on folder. voice/check-fixes.py runs every row and only says 'Every fix is in.' when all pass; the ship gate refuses a release while a yes/adapt row has no buyer_file, or no check for a computer it isn't n/a on. The author's own file names and working notes live outside this repo.

fixes.fix: Control while the clone speaks stops the voice and opens the listen in under half a second

check.pc: $a = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.youcloned-phone\pc_voice.py'; $b = Join-Path $PWD 'voice\pc_voice.py'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $a) -and ([Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($a)) -ceq [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($b)))) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

fixes.fix: Control while you talk always sends your words (no 90-second cutoff)
Option interrupt stops the sound only and keeps the conversation going (VoiceMode streaming.py patch, pinned to VoiceMode 8.12.0)

check.pc: . .\voice\pc-common.ps1; $t = Get-VoiceTool; if (-not $t) { exit 1 }; & $t.Py voice\patch-voicemode.py check; exit $LASTEXITCODE

fixes.fix: "One second, still working" waits 45 seconds and never talks over a listen
Speechify sends one request at a time and retries when told to slow down

check.pc: $a = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.youcloned-phone\speechify-voice.py'; $b = Join-Path $PWD 'voice\speechify-voice.py'; if ((-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $a)) -or ([Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($a)) -ceq [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($b)))) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

The voice chat swaps itself when it gets heavy (200k tokens or 3 hours)

fixes.fix: Windows installer no longer counts the Microsoft Store python stub as installed

check.pc: $p = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $p -or $p -match 'WindowsApps') { exit 1 }; try { & python --version *> $null } catch { exit 1 }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

fixes.fix: Mac installer works on Intel Macs again

check.mac: xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1 && git --version >/dev/null && node --version >/dev/null && python3 --version >/dev/null && claude --version >/dev/null && [ -d /Applications/Obsidian.app ] && [ -d /Applications/Cursor.app ] && { [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ] || lipo -archs /Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/MacOS/Cursor | grep -q x86_64; }

check.mac: if [ ! -f "$HOME/.youcloned/vault-path" ]; then exit 0; fi; while IFS= read -r n || [ -n "$n" ]; do [ -z "$n" ] || [ -f "$HOME/.claude/skills/$n/SKILL.md" ] || exit 1; done < skills-pack.txt
check.pc: $m = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.youcloned\vault-path'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $m)) { exit 0 }; foreach ($n in (Get-Content -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PWD 'skills-pack.txt'))) { $n = $n.Trim(); if ($n -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE (Join-Path '.claude\skills' (Join-Path $n 'SKILL.md'))))) { exit 1 } }; exit 0
